summary: The school district emphasizes the critical role of E-Rate in maintaining essential infrastructure and connectivity for modern public education, arguing that reducing or eliminating E-Rate would have direct and tangible financial impacts on school budgets and could disrupt basic operations. The technology director urges preservation of E-Rate program to ensure access to connectivity for students and schools, emphasizing its importance in modern education and technology-driven economy.

claims.requested_action: tie E-Rate decisions to educational outcomes
claims.argument: E-Rate is essential for modern public education and supports myriad operational and instructional functions
claims.evidence_quote: E-Rate is the only federal education technology program, and the connectivity it provides is foundational to supporting our students’ learning

claims.requested_action: tie E-Rate decisions to educational outcomes
claims.argument: Reducing E-Rate would have direct and tangible impact on school budgets
claims.evidence_quote: Mount Pleasant Cottage School Ufsd has received $250,615 in committed federal E-Rate support over funding years 2021–2025 — an average of roughly $50,123 a year toward the connections our students depend on.
